# HA-MCP — Manage Home Assistant with AI

The recommended way to run ha-mcp is the **HA-MCP integration**. It installs into Home Assistant through HACS (the built-in Marketplace on Home Assistant 2026.11+), runs the full server **in-process**, and works on **every** Home Assistant installation type — Home Assistant OS, Supervised, Container

1. Install the **HA-MCP integration** (requires **Home Assistant 2026.8.0 or newer**; see [compatibility details](docs/in-process-server.md#requirements)). On **Home Assistant 2026.8–2026.10**, open HACS, search for **HA-MCP**, then **Download**.
